task.description: Security-review REQ-181's implementation against INV-1 (tenant scoping), INV-4 (secret/hash column discipline), INV-7 and INV-8 as applicable. Confirm: (1) the plaintext webhook secret is never persisted, logged, or returned from any function other than create/2's own hmac_secret_once, and that Letflow.Webhooks.Subscription's struct/@type has no field that could carry it; (2) every Letflow.Webhooks function derives tenant_id from opts[:prefix] only, never from caller-supplied attrs, and list/1's tenant isolation relies on the schema-per-tenant boundary, not a filter that could be bypassed; (3) the migration's if prefix() do ... end guard and its Letflow.TenantProvisioning.tenant_scoped_migrations/0 registry entry are both present and correctly paired; (4) the SHA-256 hashing mechanism (:crypto.strong_rand_bytes/1 + :crypto.hash(:sha256, _), both hex-encoded) matches the established lib/letflow/identity.ex precedent with no weakening; (5) no route/controller/Plug file was added in this change.
acceptance_criteria: create/2 with no secret supplied generates one, stores only a hashed form in the database, and returns the plaintext exactly once as hmac_secret_once in its return value; a subsequent list/1 or get of the same subscription never includes the plaintext secret or an hmac_secret_once key at all
update/3 accepts %{status: "PAUSED"} and, separately, %{is_active: false}, and both result in a subscription that subsequently reads back as status "PAUSED"
list/1 is tenant-scoped, demonstrated structurally by schema-per-tenant isolation (a subscription created under tenant A is absent from a list/1 call scoped to tenant B)
delete/2 removes the subscription such that a subsequent list/1 no longer includes it, and a second delete/2 of the same id returns a not-found error rather than a duplicate success
the webhook_subscriptions table lives inside each tenant's Postgres schema with a tenant_id column retained, matching decision 0003 Decision B's pattern
no route or controller file is added or modified
secret_hash is the only persisted form of the secret; no changeset in this module accepts a raw secret/plaintext key
